cohort: Preterm (24-34 weeks gestation) and term fetal membranes were obtained from women with elective caesarean deliveries, PPROM, and preterm labor.
finding: Chorioamnionitis was associated with a decrease in hyaluronan concentration and degradation of decorin and biglycan in preterm amniotic membranes.
mod_finding: Labor (both term and preterm) was characterized by increased hyaluronan and biglycan concentrations in the amnion.
